name: You're Nuts!
description:
About This Game

Run through a maze to save yourself, using nothing but logic

No enemies, no fighting, only thinking. Move fast, avoid traps and solve classic puzzles to unlock new gates that open up to bigger and further rooms: more traps and harder puzzles, but also more loot and better rewards.

Watch your battery and upgrade it to push deeper into the factory!

You can only reach as far as your battery lets you, and there’s only one place where you can charge: your Safety Hub. Time doesn’t consume your battery there, so plan your day ahead. Craft equipment and overclock it, create beacons to teleport each day to your furthest discovered rooms, and save your supplies in your Storage Unit.

Don’t get caught

Fail to make it back before your battery runs out and you’ll be retrieved by the crane… It takes most of what you’re carrying, and tomorrow starts on a smaller charge. You’ll keep every route you opened and every beacon you planted, which is exactly why you’ll keep telling yourself: "just one more room."

Play it your way

Set how much loot you find, how much of it you lose if the crane retrieves you, whether the factory rotates 90° when it does, and the overall difficulty of the puzzles: pick a preset or move the sliders yourself.

And if you're colorblind, there's nothing to switch on. Every meaningful color in this game also has a shape, drawn into the puzzles themselves.

Enjoy the experience solo or in co-op

Each new game sets the factory size and puzzle rooms according to how many of you are playing, so get your crew together before you start. You all share the same battery, so every minute someone spends stuck on a puzzle is a minute the whole crew loses. You’ll cooperate in classic puzzles with a twist: Pair Up taking turns, Maze with doors and levers, and some more that will require full cooperation. Other puzzles can and will be solved just by one player, even in multiplayer games.

The last day: preparation and rush

Once you find the Exit and the Keys, one for each of you, prepare for your last day with equipment to use beacons and shortcuts. Everyone goes their own way, gets their own key, and converges on the Exit before the battery runs out. The gate is right there. Go!

Don’t forget about cute and cozy robots!

Customize your character with heads, bodies and wheels, all purely cosmetic, and worry not: you’ll be able to change any of them in-game from your Unit Assembly.

KEY FEATURES

  • Classic puzzles set up in a time-based environment

  • Charge your battery and try to reach further every day

  • Dodge traps that will cost you the one thing you can never get back: time

  • Cooperate on puzzles with up to 4 players

  • Tune the difficulty, the loot and the penalties to your taste

  • Colorblind-friendly by design: every meaningful color also has a shape

  • Find yourself asking: why can’t I stop?

You still here? You’re Nuts! Add it to your Wishlist 🤖
short_desc: A cozy co-op puzzle game for 1 to 4 cute little robots who want to be free. Unlock new rooms in an abandoned factory one puzzle at a time, and get home before your battery runs out. Every door you open stays open, so tomorrow you get deeper in. Craft, upgrade, escape. The day is short.
